prose:
A social post from bebuu_ai describes a Fireworks ultra-fast Kimi K3.1 Pro endpoint at a premium over regular and high-speed alternatives, with a stated million-token context window. It quotes vendor speed targets for generation and agentic coding.

These are a third-party post's reported prices and performance claims, not a fresh official endpoint or checkout verification. The exact availability, billing unit treatment and workload behind the speed multipliers were not inspected. Faster generation need not mean proportionally faster end-to-end work, and no request, API key or purchase was made.
highlights: Premium is compared with two other offerings
Speed targets are not independently measured
End-to-end latency can differ from generation speed
No endpoint or billing account was tested
